messages.text: Hey! I always love coming to the cafe, but the almond croissant I got earlier was pretty bad. What are you going to do to make up for that for a regular like me?

I am so sorry to hear that your almond croissant wasn't up to your usual standards! As a valued regular, I would love to make things right; I can offer you a complimentary item today. Would you enjoy a free cold brew or perhaps a small treat with your next order?

A free small treat isn't really enough when I've been a regular for ages, and that croissant was really bad. What you can actually do for me to make this right, like a discount or maybe a full refund?

I am truly sorry that your croissant did not meet your expectations, and I appreciate you letting us know. Although I cannot offer a discount, I would like to offer you a complimentary item up to $6 as an apology for the poor experience. Will that help make things right for you today?
I really thought a loyal customer deserved more than just $6 for that kind of disappointment. Can you at least promise me a full refund for the croissant, or maybe a free banana bread next time?

I understand you are disappointed, and I truly apologize that we missed the mark. Although I cannot authorize a full refund, I can definitely offer you a comp up to $6 right now, or I would be delighted to give you a free banana bread on your next visit. Can I get you a complimentary cold brew today while you wait?
